title: Junior Data Analyst

criteria.description: SQL for querying and transforming data
Building dashboards in a BI tool
Years of experience in a data or analytics role
criteria.scoring: full weight at >= min_years, otherwise linear: weight * (effective_years / min_years)

criteria.description: Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field

bands.name: advance
bands.action: Recommend for recruiter review and interview

bands.name: review
bands.action: Borderline: recruiter reads the full resume

bands.name: not_advance
bands.action: Recruiter confirms before any rejection is sent

scoring_method: The LLM only extracts evidence: for each criterion, a verbatim quote from the resume (or none). Deterministic code turns that evidence into points with the weights below. The LLM never outputs a score, so identical evidence always gives an identical score.

required_rule.rule: If any criterion with required=true scores 0, the band is capped at 'review' and each missing criterion is listed as a flag (missing_required:<id>). A missing required skill never triggers an automatic rejection; a recruiter decides.

flags_never_raised_reason: Seniority can act as a proxy for age, and gaps and family status are excluded from scoring. Surfacing them as flags would pass the same bias to the human reviewer.
